description: Druktemeting Gent Kouter Toegang trappenhallen parking 2022 is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Dienst Data en Informatie Gent. Tijdens het project Vloed werd in een proeftuin de mogelijkheden verkend voor druktemetingen. Meer info over Vloed: projectpagina Vloed Meer info over de geteste meetsystemen: overzicht geteste meetsystemen Deze dataset gaat over één van de geteste systemen op de Kouter, met name 'Peoplesense' van de firma Citymesh. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Shoppen & toerisme, Mobiliteit, Evenementen & Feesten. The portal shows 29,798 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-02-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
